subject: maths

concepts.title: Line Symmetry in Regular Polygons
concepts.definition: A regular polygon having equal side lengths and equal internal angles possesses as many fold lines of symmetry as its count of sides.
concepts.key_idea: The total number of axes of symmetry in any regular polygon is identical to its number of sides.
question_patterns: find the number of lines of symmetry for a regular polygon with n sides
how many lines of symmetry does a regular hexagon have
calculate the axes of symmetry for an equilateral triangle
state the number of lines of symmetry in a square

solution_steps.action: Equate the count of lines of symmetry to the side count
solution_steps.explain: For a regular polygon, the number of lines of symmetry equals the number of sides.

concepts.title: Order of Rotational Symmetry
concepts.definition: The order of rotational symmetry is the total number of distinct positions during a full 360-degree spin in which a shape appears identical to its original position.
concepts.key_idea: Dividing 360 degrees by the minimum rotation angle yields the order of rotational symmetry.
question_patterns: find the order of rotational symmetry if the angle of rotation is given
calculate the order of rotational symmetry for an angle of rotation of x degrees
what is the order of rotational symmetry for a shape rotating by a given angle
determine the rotational symmetry order from the angle of rotation

solution_steps.action: Divide 360 degrees by the smallest angle of rotation
solution_steps.explain: Order is determined by dividing a complete turn of 360 degrees by the fundamental angle of rotation.

concepts.title: Angle of Rotation
concepts.definition: The angle of rotation is the smallest degree measure through which an object must be rotated about its center to match its starting appearance.
concepts.key_idea: Dividing a full turn of 360 degrees by the order of rotational symmetry gives the fundamental angle of rotation.
question_patterns: find the angle of rotation for a shape with order of rotational symmetry n
calculate the minimum angle of rotation given the order
what is the angle of rotation for a regular polygon of order n
determine the angle of rotation when rotational symmetry order is known

solution_steps.action: Divide 360 degrees by the rotational symmetry order
solution_steps.explain: The minimum rotation angle is calculated by dividing 360 degrees by the given order.

concepts.title: Successive Angles of Rotational Symmetry
concepts.definition: A figure exhibiting rotational symmetry repeats its original appearance at integer multiples of its minimal rotation angle up to a complete 360-degree rotation.
concepts.key_idea: Multiplying the fundamental angle of rotation by step integers gives all intermediate positions of symmetry.
question_patterns: a figure looks identical after rotating by x degrees at what other angles does this happen
find all angles of rotation for a shape with base angle x
calculate the next angle at which the figure looks the same
list the angles of rotational symmetry up to 360 degrees

solution_steps.action: Multiply the base angle by the step multiplier
solution_steps.explain: Subsequent symmetrical angles are integer multiples of the fundamental angle of rotation.

concepts.title: Line and Rotational Symmetry in Geometric Figures
concepts.definition: Geometric figures can possess line symmetry, rotational symmetry, both, or neither, depending on their sides, angles, and overall structural uniformity.
concepts.key_idea: Shapes like circles and regular polygons exhibit both reflectional and rotational symmetry, while asymmetric shapes possess neither.
question_patterns: identify figures that have both line symmetry and rotational symmetry
name quadrilaterals with both line and rotational symmetry of order greater than 1
give examples of shapes with no line symmetry
check if a figure has both reflectional and rotational symmetry

solution_steps.explain: Check whether the shape can be folded along a straight line into two overlapping halves.
Check whether rotating the figure around a central point by an angle less than 360 degrees recreates its initial appearance.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Calculate the order of rotational symmetry for a figure whose smallest angle of rotation is {angle_of_rotation} degrees.

solution_template.action: Divide 360 degrees by the given angle of rotation
solution_template.explain: Order equals 360 divided by the angle of rotation.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Find the angle of rotation for a regular shape that has a rotational symmetry order of {order}.

solution_template.explain: Angle of rotation is 360 divided by order.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Determine the number of lines of symmetry for a regular octagon having {sides} sides.

solution_template.action: Equate lines of symmetry to number of sides
solution_template.explain: For a regular polygon, lines of symmetry equal the side count.
